name: ac-ebay-readonly
description: Read your eBay listings and account data through an explicitly restricted, local MCP server.
long_description: Unofficial local read-only eBay connector. Requires your existing eBay developer application and OAuth access token. No listing edits, purchases, messages, or account changes are exposed. Token scopes and eBay API access still limit coverage. Tokens expire; replace them in extension settings. This extension does not create credentials or automatically refresh tokens.

tools.name: ac_status
tools.description: Check configured access and coverage limits without revealing credentials.

tools.name: ac_describe_read
tools.description: Inspect one allowed operation and its inputs.

tools.name: ac_active_listings
tools.description: Read active listings, including website-created listings.

tools.name: ac_listing
tools.description: Read a listing by item ID.

user_access_token.title: eBay user access token
user_access_token.description: Paste an existing OAuth user access token from your eBay developer application. Use only the read scopes documented with this connector. Never paste it in a chat.

app_access_token.title: Application access token (optional)
app_access_token.description: Optional existing eBay application access token for public lookups. Leave blank if you do not have one.

environment.title: eBay environment
environment.description: Enter production for your real eBay account, or sandbox for an eBay test account. No other value is accepted.
